description: Use when two parties (agents, bots, contracts) have ALREADY agreed on a trade and just need a trustless way to swap: returns the signed createDeal transaction for an atomic escrow settlement on Bull. No account, no signature, no RFQ needed. Pay in ETH or USDG; the fee is returned in the response. Next call bull_settle_steps with the dealId.

buyer.description: Wallet of the side that pays. It sends the createDeal transaction.

consentOnly.description: true = return the message the SELLER must sign (personal_sign). Do this first, the seller signs, then call again with sellerSig and validUntil.

deadlineHours.description: Hours until anyone can cancel and refund both sides. Default 24, max 168.

payAmount.description: What the buyer pays, in ETH or USDG, e.g. "0.25".

sellToken.description: Token contract address the seller delivers (Robinhood Chain).

seller.description: Wallet of the side that delivers the tokens.

sellerSig.description: The seller's signature over the consent message. Required to get the createDeal transaction.

validUntil.description: Unix time until which the seller's consent is valid (returned by consentOnly).

name: bull_settle
